mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are overcast at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 68 degrees. If you are out tonight, you might spot the International Space Station, which will pass over our area starting at 8:23 PM for six minutes, traveling from the direction of Cross Plains toward the Madison area and reaching about halfway up the sky.

Regarding city news, officers were called to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on September 10 for a burglary. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was taken into custody following reports of a gunshot, and he will face charges of burglary and reckless endangerment. Additionally, the city has posted various election notices for the upcoming November general election.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have several trivia options, including at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

In a report from September 10, Verona police responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way. An officer located the suspect, who was then transported to a hospital for injuries sustained during the incident. No one else was harmed when a firearm was discharged, and the suspect remains in custody.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:00 PM today. Please be aware that the restaurant is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available.
